result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is my top recommendation.** It offers a good balance of low upfront costs, reliability, easy integration, and room to grow.

However, the best choice depends heavily on what platform your store uses.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Typical US online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent fraud protection and reporting
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for: Independent online stores, WooCommerce, and custom websites.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer familiarity)

- Fees vary by checkout product; PayPal Checkout can be around 3.49% + \$0.49
- Widely recognized by shoppers
- Offers PayPal and other payment options
- Easy to add to most online stores

Best for: Giving customers another trusted way to pay.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Basic online card rate typically 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies refunds and order management
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee

Best for: Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online processing around 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan
- Easy setup
- Online and in-person payments
- Inventory and point-of-sale tools

Best for: Businesses selling online and at physical locations.

[Square website](https://squareup.com)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Potential savings as processing volume increases
- Useful reporting and invoicing tools

Best for: Growing stores processing higher sales volumes.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

Rates are indicative US pricing; actual fees depend on payment type, plan, and eligibility. ## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Just starting an online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Using WooCommerce | Stripe |
| Want PayPal checkout too | Add PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Processing substantial monthly sales | Compare Helcim |


**My practical recommendation\:** Start with Stripe and consider adding PayPal as a second checkout option. That gives customers flexibility without adding unnecessary complexity.
